claim: SPEC.md is the Phase-I logical specification, and it has earned WITNESSED on a run independent of the code it describes.

visible_result.shows: each standing the specification has actually reached, and the exact evidence that earned it, read out of the record rather than asserted
visible_result.expect: WITNESSED reported as EARNED against WIT-007-2026-08-23-B with zero defects, and RATIFIED reported as NOT REACHABLE because it is this seat's call and not a machine's

evidence.says: the logical objects, transitions, predicates, and refusals the whole Phase-I stack is built against
the first witness run, recorded as an observation rather than a paragraph
the rerun, so the witness result is reproducible rather than a single lucky pass
the transition table compiled from SPEC.md bytes; scripts/sov_kernel.py parity fails if a participant drifts from it

why_it_matters: Every service contract, fixture, and refusal code in the repository claims to implement this document. Until it is accepted, each of them implements a proposal, and a disagreement between two services has no authority to settle it.
what_could_defeat_it: A participant whose real transitions cannot be expressed in the declared table, which scripts/sov_kernel.py parity would surface as drift.
A refusal the specification requires that no defeating fixture actually proves, meaning the witness graded coverage it did not have.
A term used in SPEC.md with a meaning CLASSIFICATION.md does not carry, which would put the two governing documents in conflict.
residuals: The witness is a model run, not a second human. It is independent of the builder, which is what WITNESSED requires, but it is not adversarial.
Four of six diagrams under diagrams/ are stale against their recorded source digests, so the drawn views of this specification lag the text.
on_accept: STATUS.yaml specification_status becomes RATIFIED, roadmap.close_f1 becomes reachable, and the O10 entry is deleted from the acceptance queue.
on_reject: SPEC.md stays WITNESSED, F1 stays open, and the rejection reason names which clause is wrong so the repair is a bounded edit rather than a rewrite.
